newsitem.title: FRANCE: France confirms ending public company wage setting.
newsitem.headline: France confirms ending public company wage setting.

text.p: The office of French Prime Minister Alain Juppe confirmed on Tuesday that he had decided to end a 14-year old practice of fixing a ceiling for wage rises at public sector companies.

The decision was taken because it was "preferable to set the framework for the wage policy company by company to better take into account their specific financial situation and the environment, monopolistic or competitive, in which they operate," a source in Juppe's office said.

The Les Echos newspaper had said this morning Juppe was ending the tradition of sending letters to other ministers informing them of a limit to wage increases in the public companies reporting to their ministry.
